violations.description: General employee cleanliness. — --Food employee did not wash hands as necessary. -Employee observed doing glove changes without handwashing.
Refrigerated Storage. — --Refrigerator or cold storage was insufficient or ineffective at maintaining potentially hazardous food at a temperature of 41F or less. -Dry Box at 46F. Sliced tomatoes etc.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface was not cleaned adequately. -Clean line and prep coolers inside. -Clean shelving in dry box cooler.--Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned adequately. -Clean all shelving in kitchen. -Clean warmer shelving on cook line.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. -Floors need thorough cleaning throughout kitchen and walk in coolers. Note-floor drain needs cleaned out at bag prep sink.--Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not maintained in good repair. -Floors and baseboards need repair in kitchen and prep area.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface was not cleaned adequately. -Clean inside microwaves and all line coolers.--Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned adequately. -Clean fronts, sides and handles on all kitchen coolers and equipment. -Clean all shelving on cook line.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…)were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. -Floors, walls and ceiling in kitchen need cleaned.--Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…)were not maintained in good repair. -Floor tiles in kitchen are in poor repair and need replaced.
